newsitem.title: USA: Midland Resources names finance chief.
newsitem.headline: Midland Resources names finance chief.

text.p: Midland Resources Inc said Thursday its board has confirmed the appointment of Howard E. Ehler as chief financial officer and vice president of finance.
He replaces Darrell Dillard, who has been acting CFO since the company moved to Houston in September 1995, a spokesman said. Dillard continues to be a member of the Midland Resources board, he added.

Ehler is a certified public accountant with over 30 years of experience in oil and gas finance, accounting, and auditing, Midland Resources said. Twenty-one of those years were with the public accounting firm of Grant Thornton, it said.

Ehler was auditor for Summit Petroleum Corp, which was acquired in 1996 by Midland Resources. He has performed done joint venture audits and consulting services for Midland Resources since the company was formed, it said.
Midland Resources specializes in the application of advanced technology for the exploration, development and production of natural gas and oil.
